int prop_bag_prop_listen (  noir_prop_bag *  b,
const char *  name,
const char *  key,
property_listener  listener,
int  tag,
void *  data
) 
 

install a listener

Returns:
an error-code
Parameters:
b the bag
name the name of the listener (usually that of the plugin the listener lives in)
key the name of the property the listener is for
listener the function to call back
tag an arbitrary tag -- when one listener listens for changes on several properties, this helps distinguishing them (without having to resort to strcmp())
data some user-data (often the session) to give the listener when called back
